p, k = map(int, input().split())
a = [0] * p
num_cycles = 0

for idx in range(p):
    if a[idx] == 0:
        num_cycles += 1
        pos = idx
        while a[pos] == 0:
            a[pos] = 1
            pos = (pos * k) % p

if k == 0:
    num_cycles = p
elif k == 1:
    num_cycles = p + 1

MOD = 1000000007
power = num_cycles - 1
result = 1
base = p % MOD
while power > 0:
    if power & 1:
        result = (result * base) % MOD
    base = (base * base) % MOD
    power >>= 1

print(result)
